_doc: Source of truth: biome_id -> AAA texture set (under D:/assets/world/textures/library/<set_id>/). prompt_seed and category drive automatic regeneration via aaa_texture.py if a set is missing or stale. As of 2026-05-06 v2, RGBA channels are assigned per-scene by biome_splat.py based on world.json's biomes list order — the per-biome splat_channel field below is now a legacy hint and is ignored at scene-bake time. This means any 4 biomes can coexist in a scene without channel collisions.

lava_field.prompt_seed: cracked volcanic basalt with glowing molten lava in fissures, dark obsidian rocks, warm orange embers, charred surface, photoreal seamless tileable
